sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.1.43
- Removed Model 360 wrap options from all Fold and Flip devices, locking coverage to Model Cut
- Configured official alpha cut masks across all MacBook Pro (M1-2021/M3 body) and MacBook Air (Top-New) models for top, bottom, and trackpad layers
- Disabled generated 3D directional shading across all Fold/Flip and MacBook devices
- Enforced persistent backend and frontend safeguards against directional shading on laptops and 360 wrap on foldables
